assertions_verified.fact: Current branch visibility is verified before stashing
Staged and unstaged changes visibility verified via status and diff
Single-file stash (git stash push notes.txt) stashes only the specified file
Stashed file working tree is restored to clean commit state
Unmentioned modified file (todo.txt) remains intact in working tree
Multi-file stash (git stash push notes.txt todo.txt) stashes exactly the named files
All Git configuration is purely local and never modifies global ~/.gitconfig
Two independent runs across separate temporary directories produce identical results
